ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
enNotes: [1429]- See footnote to 2:1.
tr: Ḥā mīm

ar: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
en: (2) By the clear Book,
tr: Wal-kitābil-mubīn

ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (3) Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
tr: Innā jaʿalnāhu qurʾānan ʿarabiyyal laʿallakum taʿqilūn

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
en: (4) And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book[1430] with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.[1431]
enNotes:
[1430]- i.e., the Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ).
[1431]- Also, "precise" or "specific."
tr: Waʾinnahū fī ummil-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīm

ar: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
en: (5) Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
tr: Afanaḍribu ʿankumudh-dhikra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawmam musrifīn

ar: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (6) And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
tr: Wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fil-awwalīn

ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (7) But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
tr: Wamā yaʾtīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (8) And We destroyed greater than them[1432] in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
enNotes: [1432]- The disbelievers of the Quraysh, who denied Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).
tr: Faʾahlaknā ashadda minhum baṭshaw wamaḍā mathalul-awwalīn

ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (9) And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
tr: Walaʾin saʾaltahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunnal-ʿazīzul-ʿalīm

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
en: (10) [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
tr: Al-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-arḍa mahdaw wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulal laʿallakum tahtadūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
en: (11) And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
tr: Wal-ladhī nazzala minas-samāʾi māʾam biqadar, faʾansharnā bihī baldatam maytā, kadhālika tukhrajūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
en: (12) And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
tr: Wal-ladhī khalaqal-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum minal-fulki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūn

ar: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
en: (13) That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.[1433]
enNotes: [1433]- Literally, "made it a companion" or "made it compatible."
tr: Litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihī thumma tadhkurū niʿmata rabbikum idhastawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahū muqrinīn

ar: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
en: (14) And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
tr: Waʾinnā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn

ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (15) But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.[1434] Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
enNotes: [1434]- By claiming that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has a son or daughters, as it is said that a child is part of his parent. This concept is totally incompatible with Allāh's unity and exclusiveness.
tr: Wajaʿalū lahū min ʿibādihī juzʾā, innal-insāna lakafūrum mubīn

ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
en: (16) Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
tr: Amittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātiw waʾaṣfākum bil-banīn

ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
en: (17) And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
tr: Waʾidhā bushshira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lir-raḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhū muswaddaw wahuwa kaẓīm

ar: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
en: (18) So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident[1435] [attributed to Allāh]?
enNotes: [1435]- Not "obvious" or "distinct" in an argument. Or not "seen," i.e., absent from battles. The reference is to a daughter.
tr: Awamay yunashshaʾu fil-ḥilyati wahuwa fil-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīn

ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
en: (19) And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
tr: Wajaʿalul-malāʾikatal-ladhīna hum ʿibādur-raḥmāni ināthā, ashahidū khalqahum, satuktabu shahādatuhum wayusʾalūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
en: (20) And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
tr: Waqālū law shāʾar-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum, mā lahum bidhālika min ʿilmin in hum illā yakhruṣūn

ar: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
en: (21) Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
tr: Am ātaynāhum kitābam min qablihī fahum bihī mustamsikūn

ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
en: (22) Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
tr: Bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāʾanā ʿalā ummatiw waʾinnā ʿalā āthārihim muhtadūn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
en: (23) And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
tr: Wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatim min nadhīrin illā qāla mutrafūhā innā wajadnā ābāʾanā ʿalā ummatiw waʾinnā ʿalā āthārihim muqtadūn

ar: قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (24) [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
tr: Qāla awalaw jiʾtukum biʾahdā mimmā wajattum ʿalayhi ābāʾakum, qālū innā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn

ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: (25) So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
tr: Fantaqamnā minhum fanẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-mukadhdhibīn

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
en: (26) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
tr: Waʾidh qāla ibrāhīmu liʾabīhi waqawmihī innanī barāʾum mimmā taʿbudūn

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
en: (27) Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
tr: Illal-ladhī faṭaranī faʾinnahū sayahdīn

ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (28) And he made it[1436] a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
enNotes: [1436]- i.e., his testimony that none is worthy of worship except Allāh.
tr: Wajaʿalahā kalimatam bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihī laʿallahum yarjiʿūn

ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (29) However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers[1437] until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.[1438]
enNotes:
[1437]- The descendants of Abraham.
[1438]- i.e., one who is obvious with a clear message, meaning Muḥammad (ﷺ).
tr: Bal mattaʿtu hāʾulāʾi waʾābāʾahum ḥattā jāʾahumul-ḥaqqu warasūlum mubīn

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (30) But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
tr: Walammā jāʾahumul-ḥaqqu qālū hādhā siḥruw waʾinnā bihī kāfirūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
en: (31) And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"[1439]
enNotes: [1439]- Referring to Makkah and aṭ-Ṭā’if.
tr: Waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhal-qurʾānu ʿalā rajulim minal-qaryatayni ʿaẓīm

ar: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
en: (32) Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
tr: Ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbik, naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fil-ḥayātid-dunyā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātil liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukhriyyā, waraḥmatu rabbika khayrum mimmā yajmaʿūn

ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
en: (33) And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers],[1440] We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
enNotes: [1440]- Who assumed that Allāh's generosity to them was a sign of His approval or who would hasten to disbelief in order to obtain wealth.
tr: Walawlā ay yakūnan-nāsu ummataw wāḥidatal lajaʿalnā limay yakfuru bir-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufam min fiḍḍatiw wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūn

ar: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
en: (34) And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
tr: Walibuyūtihim abwābaw wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiʾūn

ar: وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: (35) And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
tr: Wazukhrufā, waʾin kullu dhālika lammā matāʿul-ḥayātid-dunyā, wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil-muttaqīn

ar: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ
en: (36) And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
tr: Wamay yaʿshu ʿan dhikrir-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahū shayṭānan fahuwa lahū qarīn

ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
en: (37) And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
tr: Waʾinnahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿanis-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muhtadūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
en: (38) Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
tr: Ḥattā idhā jāʾanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿdal-mashriqayni fabiʾsal-qarīn

ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
en: (39) And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
tr: Walay yanfaʿakumul-yawma iẓ ẓalamtum annakum fil-ʿadhābi mushtarikūn

ar: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (40) Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
tr: Afaʾanta tusmiʿuṣ-ṣumma aw tahdil-ʿumya waman kāna fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
en: (41) And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
tr: Faʾimmā nadhhabanna bika faʾinnā minhum muntaqimūn

ar: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
en: (42) Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
tr: Aw nuriyannakal-ladhī waʿadnāhum faʾinnā ʿalayhim muqtadirūn

ar: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (43) So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
tr: Fastamsik bil-ladhī ūḥiya ilayk, innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
en: (44) And indeed, it is a remembrance[1441] for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
enNotes: [1441]- i.e., an honor. Or "a reminder."
tr: Waʾinnahū ladhikrul laka waliqawmik, wasawfa tusʾalūn

ar: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
en: (45) And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
tr: Wasʾal man arsalnā min qablika mir rusulinā, ajaʿalnā min dūnir-raḥmāni ālihatay yuʿbadūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (46) And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
tr: Walaqad arsalnā mūsā biʾāyātinā ilā firʿawna wamalaʾihī faqāla innī rasūlu rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
en: (47) But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
tr: Falammā jāʾahum biʾāyātinā idhā hum minhā yaḍḥakūn

ar: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (48) And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
tr: Wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukhtihā, waʾakhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
en: (49) And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
tr: Waqālū yā ayyuhas-sāḥirudʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindak, innanā lamuhtadūn

ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
en: (50) But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
tr: Falammā kashafnā ʿanhumul-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūn

ar: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
en: (51) And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
tr: Wanādā firʿawnu fī qawmihī qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mulku miṣra wahādhihil-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī, afalā tubṣirūn

ar: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
en: (52) Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?[1442]
enNotes: [1442]- That was true previous to his appointment as a prophet, at which time Allāh corrected his speech impediment.
tr: Am ana khayrum min hādhal-ladhī huwa mahīnuw walā yakādu yubīn

ar: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
en: (53) Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
tr: Falawlā ulqiya ʿalayhi aswiratum min dhahabin aw jāʾa maʿahul-malāʾikatu muqtarinīn

ar: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
en: (54) So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
tr: Fastakhaffa qawmahū faʾaṭāʿūh, innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn

ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (55) And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
tr: Falammā āsafūnantaqamnā minhum faʾaghraqnāhum ajmaʿīn

ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
en: (56) And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
tr: Fajaʿalnāhum salafaw wamathalal lil-ākhirīn

ar: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
en: (57) And when the son of Mary was presented as an example,[1443] immediately your people laughed aloud.
enNotes: [1443]- Of a creation of Allāh which is being worshipped along with Him.
tr: Walammā ḍuribabnu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka minhu yaṣiddūn

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
en: (58) And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"[1444] They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
enNotes: [1444]- Implying that they must all be the same.
tr: Waqālū aʾālihatunā khayrun am huw, mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalā, bal hum qawmun khaṣimūn

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
en: (59) He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
tr: In huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalal libanī isrāʾīl

ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
en: (60) And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another][1445] on the earth.
enNotes: [1445]- Or "succeeding [you]."
tr: Walaw nashāʾu lajaʿalnā minkum malāʾikatan fil-arḍi yakhlufūn

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
en: (61) And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.[1446] This is a straight path.
enNotes: [1446]- i.e., follow the guidance and instruction of Allāh.
tr: Waʾinnahū laʿilmul lis-sāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wattabiʿūn, hādhā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm

ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
en: (62) And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
tr: Walā yaṣuddannakumush-shayṭān, innahū lakum ʿaduwwum mubīn

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
en: (63) And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
tr: Walammā jāʾa ʿīsā bil-bayyināti qāla qad jiʾtukum bil-ḥikmati waliʾubayyina lakum baʿḍal-ladhī takhtalifūna fīh, fattaqullāha waʾaṭīʿūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
en: (64) Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
tr: Innallāha huwa rabbī warabbukum faʿbudūh, hādhā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm

ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (65) But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
tr: Fakhtalafal-aḥzābu mim baynihim, fawaylul lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīm

ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (66) Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
tr: Hal yanẓurūna illas-sāʿata an taʾtiyahum baghtataw wahum lā yashʿurūn

ar: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: (67) Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
tr: Al-akhillāʾu yawmaʾidhim baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illal-muttaqīn

ar: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
en: (68) [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
tr: Yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumul-yawma walā antum taḥzanūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
en: (69) [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
tr: Alladhīna āmanū biʾāyātinā wakānū muslimīn

ar: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
en: (70) Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,[1447] delighted."
enNotes: [1447]- i.e., those like you. Another meaning may be "your spouses," i.e., the righteous among them.
tr: Udkhulul-jannata antum waʾazwājukum tuḥbarūn

ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (71) Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
tr: Yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfim min dhahabiw waʾakwāb, wafīhā mā tashtahīhil-anfusu wataladhdhul-aʿyun, waʾantum fīhā khālidūn

ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (72) And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
tr: Watilkal-jannatul-latī ūrithtumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: (73) For you therein is much fruit[1448] from which you will eat.
enNotes: [1448]- Meaning everything delicious.
tr: Lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratum minhā taʾkulūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (74) Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
tr: Innal-mujrimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūn

ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
en: (75) It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
tr: Lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mublisūn

ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (76) And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
tr: Wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humuẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
en: (77) And they will call, "O Mālik,[1449] let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
enNotes: [1449]- Addressing the keeper of Hell.
tr: Wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuk, qāla innakum mākithūn

ar: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
en: (78) We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
tr: Laqad jiʾnākum bil-ḥaqqi walākinna aktharakum lil-ḥaqqi kārihūn

ar: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
en: (79) Or have they devised [some] affair?[1450] But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
enNotes: [1450]- Conspiracy against the Prophet (ﷺ). The reference here is to the disbelievers of Makkah.
tr: Am abramū amran faʾinnā mubrimūn

ar: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
en: (80) Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
tr: Am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum, balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūn

ar: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ
en: (81) Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."[1451]
enNotes: [1451]- Only supposing it were so, which it is not.
tr: Qul in kāna lir-raḥmāni walad, faʾana awwalul-ʿābidīn

ar: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
en: (82) Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
tr: Subḥāna rabbis-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbil-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūn

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
en: (83) So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
tr: Fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumul-ladhī yūʿadūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (84) And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī fis-samāʾi ilāhuw wafil-arḍi ilāh, wahuwal-ḥakīmul-ʿalīm

ar: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (85) And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
tr: Watabārakal-ladhī lahū mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā, waʿindahū ʿilmus-sāʿah, waʾilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (86) And those they invoke[1452] besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.[1453]
enNotes:
[1452]- i.e., worship.
[1453]- That intercession is granted exclusively by permission of Allāh to those He wills.
tr: Walā yamlikul-ladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihish-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqqi wahum yaʿlamūn

ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
en: (87) And if you asked them[1454] who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
enNotes: [1454]- Those who associate others with Allāh.
tr: Walaʾin saʾaltahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunnallāhu faʾannā yuʾfakūn

ar: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (88) And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying,[1455] "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
enNotes: [1455]- i.e., the complaint of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) about his people.
tr: Waqīlihī yārabbi inna hāʾulāʾi qawmul lā yuʾminūn

ar: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (89) So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."[1456] But they are going to know.
enNotes: [1456]- Meaning safety or security, i.e., "I will not harm you." This was before permission was granted for armed struggle.
tr: Faṣfaḥ ʿanhum waqul salām, fasawfa yaʿlamūn
